This game is such a masterpiece, I've only played one playthrough and that's all I need to make this review. 
I'm trans so I relate to the story so much and I feel the game communicates themes in a way unique to video games. 
I'm not fully out yet and I want to come out so bad but something about me can't, it feels like a mountain that is too big for me to ever climb. 
Trans or not everyone will feel this way about something in their life and this game makes you feel it. 
Not only by making a phenomenal story that makes you empathize and relate to the characters but by making you feel the difficulty, making you lose, getting close and failing, over and over again. 
There are many stories out there about overcoming a challenge but few set a requirement to feel the struggle. 
It's hard to try to analogize this to other art forms because it is truly unique to video games.

Hard but not punishing my personal experience It wasn't that hard to 100% the game considering its was my first "hard" platformer game, the only time I've actually played one was probably Mario Odyssey which I assume that most people don't consider hard so playing this game might be different for you. I really think the most logical reason that this games wasn't that hard was because of the learning curve. Starting from the Forsaken City was rough and I thought that I was gonna be almost impossible to 100% like super meat boy. But like learning the advanced tech introduced from the B-C sides weren't all that hard the only thing was hitting them consistently like wavedashing, neutral jumping, hyperdash, etc. But I really don't have any critiques aside from Theo being a little bitchy about Mr.Oshiro which I don't really think that fits his character of being laidback. I really like everything from the story, the art or background of the levels especially in chapter 4. I also Like the characters to I think my favorite is either granny or Madaline. The music too especially slaps my favorite one from the game is 3 and 7 B-sides which is so good. Of you're going for the 100% I would recommend not to but If you are than nothing is stopping and it feels really satisfying to finish everything. Overall 10/10 platformer game HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

An incredible platformer that intertwines mechanics progression with intimate, deep, and emotional story telling. With a low skill floor and high skill ceiling, this game is able to be beaten by many, mastered by few. I cannot recommend it enough even as a girl who is terrible at platformers. 

Additionally, this game was foundational for myself at the start of my gender transition. I refuse to give up, and will always keep climbing for all those we lost on the journey up the mountain.
This game is not only fun, but also learns you important live skills such as determination and self-care. Highly recommend
